label: Battery Energy & Info
info:
BatteryEnergyFlowState & BatteryInfoState

CAN data is continuously parsed and stored in flow context.
RPC calls read from context and return the current state.

RPC Methods:
- getBatteryEnergyFlowState
- getBatteryInfoState

info:
RPC methods for Battery CAN data:

1. getBatteryEnergyFlowState
   - Returns real-time battery energy flow data
   - SOC, SOH, voltage, current, temperature
   - Per-BMS details from CAN

2. getBatteryInfoState
   - Returns battery module info
   - Manufacturer, module count
   - Serial numbers, software versions
